preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of rows and columns in each test case is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each cell contains a positive integer between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n * m over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= output[0] <= m and 1 <= output[1] <= m)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or two integers representing the columns to swap to make the grid good.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 implies not any(is_good(grid) for grid in all_possible_grids)
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, it means it's impossible to make the grid good after any swap.
If the output is not -1, it means there exists a swap of columns that makes the grid good.
